title: Enemy Tracker
description: Time to Detect the Threat and Enemies!
body:
#About:

Want to make your life easier? If so, this modification offers you modern equipment that will help you spot enemies with ease!

#Working:

By clicking the right mouse button we activate or deactivate the remote control! 
When the Pilot is enabled or you're sneaking, you can right-click to change the Pilot mode. There are three modes: Normal allows you to detect mobs from a 5% range, Radial allows you to detect mobs from a 50% range, and Professional allows you to detect mobs from a 100% range!

#Ending:

As you can see, the modification is very reliable and doesn't add much, but I think it makes the game much easier! Please install it and leave a positive review!
